gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold states: 'Patient presents with headache.' Generated CC describes 'blinding headache for 3 days' but there is no gold mention of 'blinding'; the 3‑day duration is captured under HPI in gold, not CC. There is no generated fact that exactly matches the simple CC wording.
Gold: '3-day history of headache.' Generated cc-001 and hpi-001 both state headache duration of 3 days, which covers this duration information.
Gold: 'Headache starts on waking up.' No generated fact mentions temporal relation to waking.

Gold: 'Headache is located over the right eye.' Generated hpi-003: 'Headache is bilateral but worse over the right eye.' This captures that pain is worse over the right eye but adds bilaterality not in gold. Right-eye localization is covered, but with extra distribution detail.

Gold: 'Patient sees lights in front of the eyes during the headache.' Generated hpi-005: 'visual disturbances described as shooting lights.' This covers the presence of lights/visual phenomena, though the descriptor differs slightly.
Gold: 'Worse when stands up but not when bending over, coughing, or sneezing.' No generated fact describes positional or Valsalva-related change in headache.
Gold: 'Severity 5-8/10.' Generated hpi-002: 'Pain: Intense (8/10).' This covers the upper end of the reported range but omits that the severity varies between 5 and 8.

Gold: 'Ibuprofen provides slight relief but does not resolve the headache.' Generated hpi-001 and med-001: 'partial relief'/'PRN use', but they do not explicitly state that the headache is not resolved. Relief is covered; non-resolution is omitted.
Gold: 'Patient was well before this episode.' No generated fact mentions prior wellness before current episode.
Gold: 'Lacking in energy but no weight loss.' No generated fact addresses energy level or weight loss.

Gold: 'Has had previous generalized headaches which were mild and associated with altered vision.' Generated hpi-007: 'Patient has no history of similar severe headaches.' This directly conflicts with the gold fact that the patient *has* had previous (though milder) generalized headaches with associated symptoms.
Gold: 'Current headache is worse in the light (photophobia).' Generated hpi-004: 'Associated with photophobia.' This is equivalent.

Gold: 'Vision is not disturbed during the current episode.' Generated hpi-005 and asm-001 describe 'visual disturbances.' That asserts visual disturbance in the current episode, directly opposing the gold fact.
Gold: 'PMH: Nil.' Generated pmh-001: 'history of unspecific past abdominal pain.' This introduces a past medical problem when gold states none.

Gold: 'Patient is currently taking Mercilon.' Generated med-002: 'Marcelone (OCP).' This appears to refer to the same OCP but with a different spelling/name. It likely intends the same medication but is not an exact match.
Gold: 'Patient is self-treating with ibuprofen for the headache.' Generated med-001: 'Ibuprofen PRN' plus hpi-001 gives ibuprofen use for headaches. This covers current use for symptom relief.
Gold: 'Mother has migraine.' Generated fh-001: 'Mother with migraines.' Match.
Gold: 'Non-smoker.' Generated sh-002: 'Non-smoker.' Match.
Gold: 'No illicit drugs.' Generated sh-004: 'No illicit drug use.' Match.
Gold: '3 beers/week.' Generated sh-003: 'approximately three beers per week.' Match.
Gold: 'Works from home.' Generated sh-005: 'Works from home.' Match.

Gold: 'Imp: Likely migraine.' Generated asm-002: 'Possible migraine episode.' and asm-001: 'migraine-like features.' These convey a migraine diagnosis under consideration, which covers 'likely migraine' conceptually, though wording is slightly less definitive.

Gold: 'Needs neurological examination to exclude other pathology.' Generated plan-002: 'Schedule a neurological examination.' This covers arranging the exam; explicit mention of 'exclude other pathology' is omitted but intent is similar.

Gold: 'Advise regular paracetamol.' Generated plan-001: 'Prescribe a stronger NSAID with paracetamol.' Paracetamol use is covered, but the 'regular' dosing advice and the absence of a stronger NSAID in gold make this only partial alignment.

Gold: 'Prescribed an anti-inflammatory to be taken with food.' Generated plan-001: 'Prescribe stronger NSAID with paracetamol.' This covers prescribing an anti-inflammatory but omits instruction to take with food and adds combination with paracetamol.

Gold: 'Contact us straightaway or go to A&E if severe/unrelenting.' Generated plan-004: 'Consider referral to AE if symptoms worsen.' This reflects escalation to A&E for worsening symptoms but lacks 'immediately' and 'severe/unrelenting' nuance, and frames it as clinician consideration rather than explicit patient instruction.
Gold: 'No nausea/vomiting.' Generated hpi-006: 'Headaches are associated with light nausea.' This directly contradicts absence of nausea.
Gold: 'No altered taste/smell.' No generated fact mentions taste or smell.
Gold: 'No rash.' No generated fact addresses rash.

Gold: 'No coryzal symptoms.' No generated fact mentions coryzal/URI symptoms.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Duration of 3 days is supported by gold hpi-001. However, 'blinding' is not stated in gold, and gold CC only says 'headache' without descriptor or duration, so intensity descriptor is an addition.
Gold supports a 3-day history of headache and ibuprofen giving slight relief (hpi-001, hpi-007). 'Daily' is implied but not explicit; 'sudden onset' is not in gold and is an addition.
Gold hpi-006: severity 5–8/10. Generated describes intensity as 8/10 only. Upper bound is supported; describing all pain as 'intense 8/10' omits the lower end but does not contradict.
Gold: over right eye only. Generated: bilateral but worse over right eye. Right-eye predominance is supported; bilaterality is an added distribution detail not in gold.
Gold: 'Worse in the light' (photophobia). Generated explicitly states photophobia; this is equivalent.

Gold hpi-012/ros-008: 'Vision not disturbed.' Generated hpi-005 states 'occasional visual disturbances.' This directly conflicts with the gold documentation of no visual disturbance in the current episode.
Gold ros-001: 'No nausea/vomiting.' Generated hpi-006: 'associated with light nausea.' This is a direct contradiction.

Gold hpi-010: prior generalized mild headaches with altered vision. Generated hpi-007: 'no history of similar severe headaches.' This denies prior similar headaches, conflicting with gold's positive history (even if milder).
Gold mentions 'Works from home' (sh-004) but not that headaches impair ability to work. Difficulty working is an added functional impact, not supported or contradicted by gold.
Gold pmh-001: 'Nil' past medical history. Generated introduces 'unspecific past abdominal pain' as PMH, which contradicts 'nil.'
Gold med-002: patient is self-treating with ibuprofen. Generated 'ibuprofen PRN' is consistent with as-needed use; this is supported.
Gold: taking 'Mercilon.' Generated: 'Marcelone (OCP).' Likely refers to the same or similar OCP but name/spelling differs. It is best viewed as an approximate, partially supported match.
No gold fact addresses allergies or adverse reactions. 'No known allergies' is new information, neither supported nor contradicted.
Gold: 'Mum has migraine.' Generated: 'Mother with migraines.' Directly supported.

Gold: 'BP last checked 1 yr ago was normal.' Generated: 'Last BP normal one year ago.' Supported; mention of relation to contraceptive is an added context detail.

Gold assessment: 'Likely migraine.' Generated describes 'persistent headache with migraine-like features including photophobia, visual disturbances, impact on daily activities.' The migraine consideration is supported, but visual disturbances and impact on daily activities go beyond gold; additionally, visual disturbances contradict gold hpi-012/ros-008.
Gold: 'Likely migraine.' Generated: 'Possible migraine episode.' Both consider migraine; wording differs in certainty but is directionally consistent.

Gold: 'Advised regular paracetamol' and 'prescribed anti-inflammatory.' Generated: 'Prescribe stronger NSAID with paracetamol.' Use of paracetamol and an anti-inflammatory is supported, but the combination as a 'stronger NSAID' with paracetamol and the specific 'stronger' qualifier are additions.
Gold: 'needs neurological examination to exclude other pathology.' Generated: 'Schedule neurological examination.' This is supported regarding test planning.
Gold mentions only 'neurological examination'; it does not enumerate specific components like 'fundoscopy and BP check' as part of that exam. Explicitly listing these components is additional detail.

Gold: patient advised to contact clinic immediately or go to A&E if headache becomes severe or unrelenting. Generated: 'Consider referral to AE if symptoms worsen.' This reflects escalation to A&E for worsening symptoms, but shifts from explicit patient instruction to a clinician consideration and omits 'immediately' and 'severe/unrelenting' language.
